title: FIFA Council Meets in Zurich, Agrees Governance Review
detail: The FIFA Council met in Zurich on Oct 15 amid calls from rival confederation leaders for Infantino's removal. Inside World Football reports the Council agreed to a governance review, but one staffed by 'trusted' insiders rather than an independent third party. Reuters-sourced pre-meeting reporting said unseating Infantino appeared unlikely, with opponents aiming instead to curtail his executive authority ahead of the March 2027 election. Full outcome details remain thinly reported. FIFA's own release says Infantino apologised for mistakes over the withdrawn FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal, a working group was set up to examine governance reforms, and Standing Committees will review disciplinary procedures. AFC, Concacaf and UEFA presidents had asked for an independent third-party review; candidate nominations for the March 2027 election close Nov 18.

media.caption: FIFA Council: governance review agreed but staffed by insiders
